notes:
Account profile: legacy gov contractor running contact centers for multiple emergency services customers. Strict on-prem requirements; cannot accept outbound connections from agent instances.

Recent timeline:
- 2024-09-30: Intro call (AE Maya Patel + CTO) — high-level use-case: reduce SLA breaches during surge, 80% first-call resolution target.
- 2024-10-21: Tech deep-dive with infra team — network topology, existing Avaya/Genesys gateways. Customer: 'cannot touch cloud for PII or call transcripts.'
- 2024-11-05: Security questionnaire submitted; SOC2 + ISO reqs flagged, added HSM/KMS integration item.
- 2024-11-18: Onsite demo POC (Fireflies ff_2024-11-18_stonewall_demo_9f3b) — live agent-assist prototype, tool-calling via secured RPC to internal CRM; positive feedback on latency but questions about KV-cache persistence in air-gapped mode.
- 2024-11-28: POC milestone 1 complete — 2-week soak with 25 agents, synthetic surge test (2x baseline) passed for throughput but observed token-cost variance under long calls.

Requirements & constraints (from stakeholder notes):
- Workloads: agent assist (real-time suggestions), automated ticket summarization post-call, secure tool-calling to internal case system, reranking for suggested knowledge articles.
- Latency: < 150ms suggestion latency during steady state, must remain < 300ms in 95th percentile under 3x spike.
- Throughput: baseline 200 concurrent agents, surge to 1000+ during incidents.
- Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to pay for dedicated capacity if it guarantees SLOs; total cost must fit within public-sector procurement bands.
- Model preferences: certified vetted weights only (no external network pulls), support for quantized variants and smaller distilled models for low-latency inline assist.
- Routing/fallback: prefer primary on-prem model with automatic fallback to on-prem smaller-quantized replica; absolute no outbound fallback to hosted API.
- Security: air-gapped deployment, full audit logging for every inference, integration with agency SSO (SAML), HSM for key material, 7-year retention for call transcripts per regulation.

Sales/POC notes (shorthand):
- SE Ethan Brooks leading architecture; follow-up on KV persistence options for air-gap (local disk vs encrypted NFS).
- Need written confirmation from eng that automatic model update mechanism can be disabled; all model files delivered via sealed media.
- Customer asks for runbook for failover behavior during node failures and explicit SLA language around surge capacity.

Quotes from stakeholders:
- "We will not accept any outbound telemetry; installer must be copyable to an air-gapped USB and hand-delivered." — Director, IT Ops
- "If you can prove no cloud egress and meet latency under spike, procurement will move fast." — Head of Contact Center Ops

Next steps (short):
- Provide sealed-media delivery plan + install runbook (due 2024-12-10).
- Draft SOW with surge SLA and HSM integration options (internal legal review).
- Schedule security acceptance review with CISO team (target week of 2024-12-15).
